items.headline: Re’Shaun Sanford II breaks tie with long TD run as No. 17 Houston beats Cincinnati 31-24
items.description: — Re’Shaun Sanford II ran for 126 yards and the tiebreaking score in the fourth quarter, and Conner Weigman threw for 227 yards and two touchdowns as No. 17 Houston beat Cincinnati 31-24 on Saturday.

items.headline: College Football Playoff Bubble Watch after first ranking
items.description: A conference-by-conference look at which teams are contending for the playoff, who's close and who's out.

items.headline: No. 17 Houston and Cincinnati meet in Big 12 action
items.description: Cincinnati (5-3) at No. 17 Houston (6-2), Nov. 7 at 3:30 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Kickers and a resurgent USC steal the show in Week 9
items.description: Kickers came through in the clutch in Week 9, and elsewhere, Miami, Utah and UCLA all stayed undefeated.

items.headline: No. 6 Utah improves to 8-0 with 49-25 win over Cincinnati
items.description: — Devon Dampier threw for 260 yards and two touchdowns and No. 6 Utah extended the nation’s longest active winning streak with a 49-25 victory over Cincinnati on Saturday.
